items.item_text: Epic Clarity/Clinical Data Model accredited or certification
Master’s degree, or equivalent experience or training in Health Informatics, Public Health, Healthcare Administration, Information Management Systems, Computer Science, or a related field

Experience with data ingestion, high-performance streaming, transformation, and quality frameworks (e.g., Fivetran, dbt, Orchestra) for maintaining reliable pipelines across clinical and enterprise sources

This position develops expertise and informatics technology to enable clinicians, researchers, and staff to improve patient health outcomes and advance toward a learning system at UC Davis Health (UCDH).

The Clinical Informatics Specialist has a functional reporting relationship to the Enterprise Analytics and Data Services within the division of Information Technology and serves as a key member of the Pharmacy Domain Specific Unit (DSU) under the Pharmacy Manager. The Clinical Informatics Specialist participates in all aspects of the design, development, and implementation of data and analytical products for the Pharmacy domain, as prioritized by leadership. Responsibilities include requirements gathering, data acquisition from multiple sources, data quality assurance, statistical data validation, semantic curation, data architecture, and data transformation and translation. The incumbent may also contribute to strategic initiatives and business development efforts by evaluating and enhancing data tools and advising on data strategy.
Demonstrated capacity to mentor team members and promote data quality standards and best practices across both technical teams and clinical stakeholders
Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to assess data quality, identify risks, and develop practical solutions in regulated environments
